purpose: Explicit exceptions to central GHA Hint persistence. An entry permits only the listed staging scopes; every other maintained workflow remains report-only for canonical Hint stores.

entries.rationale: Variant-family generation is a canonical family-dataset producer rather than a solver-discovery ingestion lane. It writes family levels and their sibling Hint artifacts together through the shared semantic/physical I/O boundary on the dedicated research branch. The exception is intentionally limited to data/families/ and does not authorize published/stress Hint persistence.
